ORIGINAL PRACTICE / NOT OFFICIAL TEST QUESTIONS

每周写作与口语题卡

全部题目由本计划自编，用于迁移练习，不是官方真题、预测或押题。正式模拟请用未见合法完整试卷。自编题可以练习，也可以请老师反馈，但不能冒充官方考试成绩。

Task2：至少250词，约40分钟。口语：Part2准备1分钟、说1–2分钟；Part3回答原因、比较、后果与条件，不背完整稿。材料页本身不计时、不收录音。

Week 1

TASK 2 · A / 自编迁移题

先独立审题与列纲

Some university students prefer to study entirely online, while others value face-to-face classes. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.

检查：是否回应全部任务；每个观点有没有解释与具体例证；是否过度泛化。保存原稿，再按反馈修改。

打开官方写作评分标准

TASK 2 · B / 自编迁移题

先独立审题与列纲

Universities should give students more practical projects and fewer written examinations. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.

检查：是否回应全部任务；每个观点有没有解释与具体例证；是否过度泛化。保存原稿，再按反馈修改。

打开官方写作评分标准

SPEAKING / 自编Part 1–3题卡

Part 1：自然短答

  1. What do you enjoy studying?
  2. When do you study most effectively?
  3. Do you prefer working alone or with others?

Part 2：Describe a course that changed the way you learn.

You should say what it was, when and where it happened, who was involved, and explain why it was important to you.

这是可调整的自编提示，答题时选真实相关信息；不要为了套材料虚构经历。

Part 3：延伸与追问

  1. What makes a course useful?
  2. Should all university courses include practical work?
  3. How has technology changed learning?

回听只挑两个问题，下次换问法验证。答得长不等于答得好，先相关再展开。

打开官方口语评分标准
